Theme

Travel & transport

journey noun and verb

also travel, make a trip, trip, march (of an army)

classical

Traupman 219

iter, itineris n.

noun, third declension

Other words

  • iter facere — travel, make a trip

    classical · Traupman 219; Traupman 187: march; Traupman 219: travel; Traupman 206

Examples

  • Post quīnque diēs, diē Sāturnī, iter faciēmus: domō proficīscēmur et in Lūsitāniam ībimus

    In five days, on Saturday, we’ll go on a journey: we’ll set out from home and go to PortugalLibellus I, Iter in Lūsitāniam

See also set out, arrive, return, traveller, abroad.
